i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; For the file structure, I'm keeping idx3, initializeGrid, validateResult, and printUsage from the original design but replacing the CPU reference stencil function with the actual CUDA kernel implementation to avoid dead code and warnings.\n\nWriting includes and setup code...\n\nNow I'm working out the domain decomposition logic: a block-range helper that splits a dimension across ranks as evenly as possible, plus a dimension-choosing function that searches over factorizations of the process count to find a 3D process grid that divides evenly into the given nx, ny, nz without exceeding any axis.\n\nStill writing decomposition logic...\n\nI'm using a cost metric based on total halo exchange volume, favoring process grids that minimize cross-rank boundary faces, and defining padded indexing and kernel structures for the CUDA stencil computation.\n\nWriting CUDA kernel structs...\n\nWriting face packing kernel...\n\nFinishing the kernel logic...\n\nNow I'm working out the buffer layout, computing the offset and size for each axis's face based on the dimensions perpendicular to that axis.\n\nI need to be careful about which layer gets packed for sending versus which halo gets unpacked on receive: my low-side face (layer 0) goes to my low neighbor, who stores it in their high-side halo, so the segment index for sending corresponds to my face direction, while the segment I receive from a given neighbor corresponds to their opposite-side face.\n\nI'm outlining the host buffer logic: pack the device halo faces into contiguous send buffers, copy to host, then issue MPI_Isend/Irecv pairs per direction with tag `d` for sends and tag `opp(d)` for receives, using MPI_PROC_NULL for boundary directions so those calls become no-ops. After the exchange completes I copy the receive buffer back to device and unpack each halo region whose neighbor actually exists.\n\nNow I'm sketching the main function: initializing MPI, parsing command-line arguments on all ranks, validating grid dimensions, choosing a 3D process grid via `chooseDims`, creating a Cartesian communicator, and retrieving each rank's coordinates within it.\n\nI'm computing each rank's local block range per dimension and figuring out its six neighbor ranks via `MPI_Cart_shift` for each axis. Then for GPU assignment, I'm splitting the communicator by shared-memory node to get a local rank, checking the CUDA device count, and assigning each process a GPU via round-robin based on its local rank.\n\nNow I'm planning memory allocation: computing padded local grid dimensions with halo cells, allocating two device buffers for the grid and zeroing them, then initializing the owned cells on the host with OpenMP before copying to the device—keeping that host buffer scoped locally since it's only needed for the initial setup.\n\nI'm setting up non-blocking CUDA streams and timing-disabled events for overlapping computation and communication, defining host-side shell/box geometry for the halo regions, and writing a kernel launch helper that computes grid and block dimensions based on each box's extent before dispatching the stencil kernel.\n\nNow I'm double-checking the grid dimension limits, since gridDim.z is capped at 65535 on compute capability 3.0+ hardware, which could overflow for very large z extents and might need an adjusted block/grid shape to stay within bounds.\n\nWriting the kernel bounds check...\n\nAdding grid-stride loops to the pack kernel for safety, then sketching the main loop setup with interior/shell box construction...\n\nDefining the xlo/xhi boundary boxes the same way, then double-checking edge cases where a dimension is only 1 to make sure the shell regions still cover every face correctly.\n\nWriting the main iteration loop...\n\nSyncing the comm stream after the copy, then exchanging halos over MPI and copying received data back to device before unpacking on valid neighbors. I record an event on the comm stream and make the compute stream wait on it before launching the shell computations in order.\n\nNow I'm double-checking the ordering: pack reads `in`'s data, which depends on the previous shell event, and that wait happens before packing starts, so that's fine. The unpack writes into `in`'s halo region, which was already handled earlier, and the host-to-device copy from the pinned receive buffer happens safely after the MPI wait completes, with the next iteration's receive only starting after the stream sync that follows the copy. I'm now checking the pack buffer for similar ordering issues.\n\nThe pack buffer written by the next iteration's kernel depends on the current iteration's device-to-host copy finishing, which is guaranteed by the stream synchronization point. After the main loop, I need a final device synchronize, and I'm noting CUDA-aware MPI isn't required here. stencil and halo pack/unpack run as kernels.\n//            The interior is computed while halos are exchanged, then the boundary shell.\n//   OpenMP : host-side initialization, gather and scatter for result output/validation.\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// 3D index calculation (global grid, same linear layout as the serial code)\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Index into a locally padded block: owned cells are [0,lx)x[0,ly)x[0,lz),\n// with one halo layer at coordinates -1 and l.\n__host__ __device__ inline size_t padIdx(const int x, const int y, const int z, const int sx, const int sy) noexcept {\n    return (static_cast<size_t>(z + 1) * sy + static_cast<size_t>(y + 1)) * sx + static_cast<size_t>(x + 1);\n}\n\n// Geometry of one rank's sub-domain\nstruct Geom {\n    int nx, ny, nz;  // global grid size\n    int x0, y0, z0;  // global origin of owned block\n    int lx, ly, lz;  // owned block extents\n    int sx, sy;      // padded strides (lx+2, ly+2)\n};\n\n// Rectangular box of owned cells (local coordinates)\nstruct Box {\n    int ox, oy, oz;\n    int ex, ey, ez;\n};\n\n// Face numbering: 0:-x 1:+x 2:-y 3:+y 4:-z 5:+z ; opposite face is d^1\nstruct Range {\n    int start;\n    int len;\n};\n\nstatic Range blockRange(const int n, const int p, const int c) {\n    const int base = n / p;\n    const int rem = n % p;\n    Range r;\n    r.len = base + (c < rem ? 1 : 0);\n    r.start = c * base + std::min(c, rem);\n    return r;\n}\n\n// Choose a 3D process grid px*py*pz == P minimizing total halo volume\nstatic bool chooseDims(const int P, const int nx, const int ny, const int nz, int dims[3]) {\n    bool found = false;\n    double best = 0.0;\n    for (int px = 1; px <= P; ++px) {\n        if (P % px != 0 || px > nx) continue;\n        const int rest = P / px;\n        for (int py = 1; py <= rest; ++py) {\n            if (rest % py != 0 || py > ny) continue;\n            const int pz = rest / py;\n            if (pz > nz) continue;\n            const double cost = double(px - 1) * ny * nz + double(py - 1) * nx * nz + double(pz - 1) * nx * ny;\n            if (!found || cost < best) {\n                found = true;\n                best = cost;\n                dims[0] = px;\n                dims[1] = py;\n                dims[2] = pz;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return found;\n}\n\n// Packed halo layout: per face d, number of cells and offset in the packed buffer\nstatic size_t faceLayout(const Geom& g, size_t off[6], size_t cnt[6]) {\n    const int L[3] = {g.lx, g.ly, g.lz};\n    size_t total = 0;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 6; ++d) {\n        const int axis = d >> 1;\n        const int a0 = (axis == 0) ? 1 : 0;\n        const int a1 = (axis == 2) ? 1 : 2;\n        cnt[d] = static_cast<size_t>(L[a0]) * static_cast<size_t>(L[a1]);\n        off[d] = total;\n        total += cnt[d];\n    }\n    return total;\n}\n\n// Partition the owned block into disjoint boxes covering all cells whose\n// 7-point neighborhood touches the halo (the \"shell\"). Empty boxes are skipped.\nstatic std::vector<Box> buildShells(const int lx, const int ly, const int lz) {\n    const int iy = std::max(ly - 2, 0);\n    const int iz = std::max(lz - 2, 0);\n    std::vector<Box> s;\n    s.push_back({0, 0, 0, lx, ly, 1});            // z = 0\n    if (lz >= 2) s.push_back({0, 0, lz - 1, lx, ly, 1});  // z = lz-1\n    s.push_back({0, 0, 1, lx, 1, iz});            // y = 0\n    if (ly >= 2) s.push_back({0, ly - 1, 1, lx, 1, iz});  // y = ly-1\n    s.push_back({0, 1, 1, 1, iy, iz});            // x = 0\n    if (lx >= 2) s.push_back({lx - 1, 1, 1, 1, iy, iz});  // x = lx-1\n    return s;\n}\n\n// Interior: owned cells whose neighbors are all owned (no halo access)\nstatic Box buildInterior(const int lx, const int ly, const int lz) {\n    return {1, 1, 1, std::max(lx - 2, 0), std::max(ly - 2, 0), std::max(lz - 2, 0)};\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil on a box of owned cells. Global boundary cells are copied.\n__global__ void stencilBoxKernel(const Real* __restrict__ in, Real* __restrict__ out, const Box b, const Geom g) {\n    const size_t sz = static_cast<size_t>(g.sx) * static_cast<size_t>(g.sy);\n    const size_t sy = static_cast<size_t>(g.sx);\n    const int x = b.ox + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (x >= b.ox + b.ex) return;\n    const int gx = g.x0 + x;\n    const bool xBoundary = (gx == 0) || (gx == g.nx - 1);\n    for (int y = b.oy + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y; y < b.oy + b.ey; y += gridDim.y * blockDim.y) {\n        const int gy = g.y0 + y;\n        const bool yBoundary = xBoundary || (gy == 0) || (gy == g.ny - 1);\n        for (int z = b.oz + blockIdx.z; z < b.oz + b.ez; z += gridDim.z) {\n            const size_t p = padIdx(x, y, z, g.sx, g.sy);\n            const int gz = g.z0 + z;\n            if (yBoundary || gz == 0 || gz == g.nz - 1) {\n                out[p] = in[p];\n            } else {\n                const Real center = in[p];\n                const Real left = in[p - 1];\n                const Real right = in[p + 1];\n                const Real front = in[p - sy];\n                const Real back = in[p + sy];\n                const Real bottom = in[p - sz];\n                const Real top = in[p + sz];\n                // Simple averaging stencil (same operation order as the serial version)\n                out[p] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Copy one owned face layer into a contiguous buffer (UNPACK=false),\n// or write a received buffer into the halo layer (UNPACK=true).\ntemplate <bool UNPACK>\n__global__ void faceKernel(Real* __restrict__ field, Real* __restrict__ buf, const int d, const Geom g) {\n    const int axis = d >> 1;\n    const bool hi = (d & 1) != 0;\n    const int L[3] = {g.lx, g.ly, g.lz};\n    const int a0 = (axis == 0) ? 1 : 0;\n    const int a1 = (axis == 2) ? 1 : 2;\n    const int nu = L[a0];\n    const int nv = L[a1];\n    int c[3];\n    if (UNPACK) {\n        c[axis] = hi ? L[axis] : -1;\n    } else {\n        c[axis] = hi ? L[axis] - 1 : 0;\n    }\n    for (int v = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y; v < nv; v += gridDim.y * blockDim.y) {\n        for (int u = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; u < nu; u += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n            c[a0] = u;\n            c[a1] = v;\n            const size_t p = padIdx(c[0], c[1], c[2], g.sx, g.sy);\n            const size_t q = static_cast<size_t>(v) * nu + u;\n            if (UNPACK) {\n                field[p] = buf[q];\n            } else {\n                buf[q] = field[p];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void launchStencil(const Real* in, Real* out, const Box& b, const Geom& g, cudaStream_t s) {\n    if (b.ex <= 0 || b.ey <= 0 || b.ez <= 0) return;\n    const dim3 block(32, 8, 1);\n    const dim3 grid((b.ex + 31) / 32, std::min((b.ey + 7) / 8, 65535), std::min(b.ez, 65535));\n    stencilBoxKernel<<<grid, block, 0, s>>>(in, out, b, g);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\ntemplate <bool UNPACK>\nstatic void launchFaces(Real* field, Real* packed, const int nb[6], const size_t off[6], const size_t cnt[6],\n                        const Geom& g, cudaStream_t s) {\n    const int L[3] = {g.lx, g.ly, g.lz};\n    for (int d = 0; d < 6; ++d) {\n        if (nb[d] == MPI_PROC_NULL) continue;  // no neighbor on this side\n        const int axis = d >> 1;\n        const int a0 = (axis == 0) ? 1 : 0;\n        const int a1 = (axis == 2) ? 1 : 2;\n        const dim3 block(32, 8, 1);\n        const dim3 grid((L[a0] + 31) / 32, std::min((L[a1] + 7) / 8, 65535), 1);\n        faceKernel<UNPACK><<<grid, block, 0, s>>>(field, packed + off[d], d, g);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        (void)cnt;\n    }\n}\n\n// Exchange packed faces with the 6 neighbors (MPI_PROC_NULL sides are no-ops).\nstatic void exchangeHalos(const int nb[6], const size_t off[6], const size_t cnt[6], Real* hSend, Real* hRecv,\n                          MPI_Comm comm) {\n    MPI_Request req[12];\n    int n = 0;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 6; ++d) {\n        // Data arriving on my side d was sent by neighbor d as its face d^1.\n        MPI_Irecv(hRecv + off[d], static_cast<int>(cnt[d]), MPI_DOUBLE, nb[d], d ^ 1, comm, &req[n++]);\n    }\n    for (int d = 0; d < 6; ++d) {\n        MPI_Isend(hSend + off[d], static_cast<int>(cnt[d]), MPI_DOUBLE, nb[d], d, comm, &req[n++]);\n    }\n    MPI_Waitall(n, req, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n}\n\n// OpenMP-parallel initialization of owned cells (global index formula from the serial code)\nstatic void initializeLocal(std::vector<Real>& pad, const Geom& g) {\n#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (int z = 0; z < g.lz; ++z) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < g.ly; ++y) {\n            for (int x = 0; x < g.lx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(static_cast<size_t>(g.x0 + x), static_cast<size_t>(g.y0 + y),\n                                        static_cast<size_t>(g.z0 + z), static_cast<size_t>(g.nx),\n                                        static_cast<size_t>(g.ny));\n                pad[padIdx(x, y, z, g.sx, g.sy)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// OpenMP-parallel extraction of the owned block into a contiguous (z,y,x) array\nstatic void extractOwned(const std::vector<Real>& pad, std::vector<Real>& block, const Geom& g) {\n    block.resize(static_cast<size_t>(g.lx) * g.ly * g.lz);\n#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (int z = 0; z < g.lz; ++z) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < g.ly; ++y) {\n            for (int x = 0; x < g.lx; ++x) {\n                block[(static_cast<size_t>(z) * g.ly + y) * g.lx + x] = pad[padIdx(x, y, z, g.sx, g.sy)];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// OpenMP-parallel scatter of a contiguous block into the global grid\nstatic void scatterBlock(std::vector<Real>& global, const std::vector<Real>& block, const int x0, const int y0,\n                         const int z0, const int lx, const int ly, const int lz, const int nx, const int ny) {\n#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (int z = 0; z < lz; ++z) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < ly; ++y) {\n            for (int x = 0; x < lx; ++x) {\n                const size_t gi = idx3(static_cast<size_t>(x0 + x), static_cast<size_t>(y0 + y),\n                                       static_cast<size_t>(z0 + z), static_cast<size_t>(nx), static_cast<size_t>(ny));\n                global[gi] = block[(static_cast<size_t>(z) * ly + y) * lx + x];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    size_t nx = 128;\n    size_t ny = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n\n    if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nz < 1 || nx > (1u << 30) || ny > (1u << 30) || nz > (1u << 30)) {\n        if (rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"Invalid grid size\\n\");\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n        printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // 3D Cartesian decomposition of the grid over MPI ranks\n    int dims[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    if (!chooseDims(size, static_cast<int>(nx), static_cast<int>(ny), static_cast<int>(nz), dims)) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Cannot decompose %zux%zux%zu grid over %d ranks (need px*py*pz == ranks, px<=nx, py<=ny, pz<=nz)\\n\",\n                    nx, ny, nz, size);\n        }\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    int periods[3] = {0, 0, 0};\n    MPI_Comm cart;\n    MPI_Cart_create(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 3, dims, periods, 0, &cart);\n    int coords[3];\n    MPI_Cart_coords(cart, rank, 3, coords);\n\n    int nb[6];  // neighbor ranks per face (MPI_PROC_NULL at domain edges)\n    for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {\n        int src = MPI_PROC_NULL;\n        int dst = MPI_PROC_NULL;\n        MPI_Cart_shift(cart, a, 1, &src, &dst);\n        nb[2 * a] = src;\n        nb[2 * a + 1] = dst;\n    }\n\n    const Range rx = blockRange(static_cast<int>(nx), dims[0], coords[0]);\n    const Range ry = blockRange(static_cast<int>(ny), dims[1], coords[1]);\n    const Range rz = blockRange(static_cast<int>(nz), dims[2], coords[2]);\n    Geom g{};\n    g.nx = static_cast<int>(nx);\n    g.ny = static_cast<int>(ny);\n    g.nz = static_cast<int>(nz);\n    g.x0 = rx.start;\n    g.y0 = ry.start;\n    g.z0 = rz.start;\n    g.lx = rx.len;\n    g.ly = ry.len;\n    g.lz = rz.len;\n    g.sx = g.lx + 2;\n    g.sy = g.ly + 2;\n\n    // One GPU per rank: select device by node-local rank\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n    int numDevices = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&numDevices));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % numDevices));\n\n    // Device buffers (double buffering, padded with one halo layer)\n    const size_t padTotal = static_cast<size_t>(g.sx) * g.sy * (g.lz + 2);\n    Real* dGrid[2];\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792979296385,"sessionID":"ses_e8a1f1807ffe4qXgX3rcoNVZme","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_015SJYMt6BcQAA1CuGpPSYn8","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/stencil3d_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_hybrid_r1/stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt","content":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)\nproject(stencil3d_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nfind_package(MPI REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)\nfind_package(OpenMP REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)\nfind_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)\n\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n  if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL 3.24)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native)\n  else()\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 70 80 86)\n  endif()\nendif()\n\n# stencil3d.cpp contains both host code (MPI, OpenMP) and CUDA kernels,\n# so it is compiled by nvcc with host-side OpenMP/optimization flags forwarded.\nset_source_files_properties(stencil3d.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\nadd_executable(stencil3d stencil3d.cpp)\n\n# Enable optimizations\ntarget_compile_options(stencil3d PRIVATE\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3>\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-Xcompiler=-O3>\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-Xcompiler=-march=native>\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-Xcompiler=-fopenmp>\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-Xcompiler=-Wall>\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-Xcompiler=-Wextra>)\n\ntarget_link_options(stencil3d PRIVATE -Xcompiler=-fopenmp)\n\n# MPI, OpenMP, CUDA runtime, and math library\ntarget_link_libraries(stencil3d PRIVATE MPI::MPI_CXX OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX CUDA::cudart m)\n"},"output":"Wrote file {"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1792979528590,"sessionID":"ses_e8a1f1807ffe4qXgX3rcoNVZme","part":{"id":"prt_175e80428001ehi0X3k25gx8hv","messageID":"msg_175e8007d0012YHpYvIJ1vnKET","sessionID":"ses_e8a1f1807ffe4qXgX3rcoNVZme","type":"reasoning","text":"I'm seeing x1 with np=1 output \"Performance: inf\" passing validation, and tracing back through the run history where x2 with np=3 failed, np=4 succeeded, but np=6 seems to have triggered an MPI abort that may have caused a hang.\n\nThat likely explains the overall timeout—cumulative startup time across dozens of CUDA-initializing mpirun invocations across all configs probably exceeded the limit rather than any single run hanging. The x1 np=2 failure makes sense too, since a 1-cell grid genuinely can't be split across 2 ranks.\n\nNow I'm weighing whether to handle non-decomposable cases more gracefully, like falling back to the largest rank count that actually divides evenly and letting extra ranks sit idle, though that adds complexity to the reduction logic.\n\nI'm deciding to implement this by shrinking the active rank count until a valid decomposition exists, then using MPI_Comm_split to separate active workers from idle ranks—idle ranks get MPI_COMM_NULL and participate only in the final timing reduction and barrier with a zero contribution so they don't skew the max time result.\n\nIdle ranks should still join the node-local GPU device split since that's collective across the world communicator, even though their cudaSetDevice call is harmless and unused. Rather than wrapping the whole main function body in a null-check conditional, I'm leaning toward extracting the actual benchmark logic into a separate function that only active ranks call, keeping main cleaner.\n\nI need to reduce elapsed time across all world ranks with idle ones contributing zero, then print computation time and performance before the results themselves — so the ordering means timing has to be computed and printed before runBenchmark emits results, not after.\n\nSimplifying this, I'll restructure so that active ranks wrap the setup, init, and loop in a conditional block, while idle ranks skip straight to the timing reduction and final broadcast, keeping main mostly linear rather than splitting logic into separate helper functions.\n\nBut I'm second-guessing whether this complexity is even necessary -- the rank-count-versus-grid mismatch is really an edge case, only breaking down when the factorization can't fit the dimensions (like a prime number of ranks exceeding the grid dims), which might not be worth engineering around for typical test configurations.\n\nI decide it's safer to implement the active-subset fallback anyway since it's a relatively small amount of code, rather than relying on an abort. {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792979561334,"sessionID":"ses_e8a1f1807ffe4qXgX3rcoNVZme","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01RRvqB2i71vPcYsQ1nGsvT1","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/stencil3d_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_hybrid_r1/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing Real = double;\n\n// Hybrid parallelization:\n//   MPI    : 3D Cartesian domain decomposition, one rank per sub-domain, halo exchange.\n//   CUDA   : each rank drives one GPU; stencil and halo pack/unpack run as kernels.\n//            The interior is computed while halos are exchanged, then the boundary shell.\n//   OpenMP : host-side initialization, gather and scatter for result output/validation.\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,       \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// 3D index calculation (global grid, same linear layout as the serial code)\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Index into a locally padded block: owned cells are [0,lx)x[0,ly)x[0,lz),\n// with one halo layer at coordinates -1 and l.\n__host__ __device__ inline size_t padIdx(const int x, const int y, const int z, const int sx, const int sy) noexcept {\n    return (static_cast<size_t>(z + 1) * sy + static_cast<size_t>(y + 1)) * sx + static_cast<size_t>(x + 1);\n}\n\n// Geometry of one rank's sub-domain\nstruct Geom {\n    int nx, ny, nz;  // global grid size\n    int x0, y0, z0;  // global origin of owned block\n    int lx, ly, lz;  // owned block extents\n    int sx, sy;      // padded strides (lx+2, ly+2)\n};\n\n// Rectangular box of owned cells (local coordinates)\nstruct Box {\n    int ox, oy, oz;\n    int ex, ey, ez;\n};\n\nstruct Range {\n    int start;\n    int len;\n};\n\n// Face numbering: 0:-x 1:+x 2:-y 3:+y 4:-z 5:+z ; opposite face is d^1\nstatic Range blockRange(const int n, const int p, const int c) {\n    const int base = n / p;\n    const int rem = n % p;\n    Range r;\n    r.len = base + (c < rem ? 1 : 0);\n    r.start = c * base + std::min(c, rem);\n    return r;\n}\n\n// Choose a 3D process grid px*py*pz == P minimizing total halo volume.\n// Each dimension must not exceed the grid size so every block is non-empty.\nstatic bool chooseDims(const int P, const int nx, const int ny, const int nz, int dims[3]) {\n    bool found = false;\n    double best = 0.0;\n    for (int px = 1; px <= P; ++px) {\n        if (P % px != 0 || px > nx) continue;\n        const int rest = P / px;\n        for (int py = 1; py <= rest; ++py) {\n            if (rest % py != 0 || py > ny) continue;\n            const int pz = rest / py;\n            if (pz > nz) continue;\n            const double cost = double(px - 1) * ny * nz + double(py - 1) * nx * nz + double(pz - 1) * nx * ny;\n            if (!found || cost < best) {\n                found = true;\n                best = cost;\n                dims[0] = px;\n                dims[1] = py;\n                dims[2] = pz;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return found;\n}\n\n// Packed halo layout: per face d, number of cells and offset in the packed buffer\nstatic size_t faceLayout(const Geom& g, size_t off[6], size_t cnt[6]) {\n    const int L[3] = {g.lx, g.ly, g.lz};\n    size_t total = 0;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 6; ++d) {\n        const int axis = d >> 1;\n        const int a0 = (axis == 0) ? 1 : 0;\n        const int a1 = (axis == 2) ? 1 : 2;\n        cnt[d] = static_cast<size_t>(L[a0]) * static_cast<size_t>(L[a1]);\n        off[d] = total;\n        total += cnt[d];\n    }\n    return total;\n}\n\n// Partition the owned block into disjoint boxes covering all cells whose\n// 7-point neighborhood touches the halo (the \"shell\"). Empty boxes are skipped.\nstatic std::vector<Box> buildShells(const int lx, const int ly, const int lz) {\n    const int iy = std::max(ly - 2, 0);\n    const int iz = std::max(lz - 2, 0);\n    std::vector<Box> s;\n    s.push_back({0, 0, 0, lx, ly, 1});                    // z = 0\n    if (lz >= 2) s.push_back({0, 0, lz - 1, lx, ly, 1});  // z = lz-1\n    s.push_back({0, 0, 1, lx, 1, iz});                    // y = 0\n    if (ly >= 2) s.push_back({0, ly - 1, 1, lx, 1, iz});  // y = ly-1\n    s.push_back({0, 1, 1, 1, iy, iz});                    // x = 0\n    if (lx >= 2) s.push_back({lx - 1, 1, 1, 1, iy, iz});  // x = lx-1\n    return s;\n}\n\n// Interior: owned cells whose neighbors are all owned (no halo access)\nstatic Box buildInterior(const int lx, const int ly, const int lz) {\n    return {1, 1, 1, std::max(lx - 2, 0), std::max(ly - 2, 0), std::max(lz - 2, 0)};\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil on a box of owned cells. Global boundary cells are copied.\n__global__ void stencilBoxKernel(const Real* __restrict__ in, Real* __restrict__ out, const Box b, const Geom g) {\n    const size_t sz = static_cast<size_t>(g.sx) * static_cast<size_t>(g.sy);\n    const size_t sy = static_cast<size_t>(g.sx);\n    const int x = b.ox + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (x >= b.ox + b.ex) return;\n    const int gx = g.x0 + x;\n    const bool xBoundary = (gx == 0) || (gx == g.nx - 1);\n    for (int y = b.oy + blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y; y < b.oy + b.ey; y += gridDim.y * blockDim.y) {\n        const int gy = g.y0 + y;\n        const bool xyBoundary = xBoundary || (gy == 0) || (gy == g.ny - 1);\n        for (int z = b.oz + blockIdx.z; z < b.oz + b.ez; z += gridDim.z) {\n            const size_t p = padIdx(x, y, z, g.sx, g.sy);\n            const int gz = g.z0 + z;\n            if (xyBoundary || gz == 0 || gz == g.nz - 1) {\n                out[p] = in[p];\n            } else {\n                const Real center = in[p];\n                const Real left = in[p - 1];\n                const Real right = in[p + 1];\n                const Real front = in[p - sy];\n                const Real back = in[p + sy];\n                const Real bottom = in[p - sz];\n                const Real top = in[p + sz];\n                // Simple averaging stencil (same operation order as the serial version)\n                out[p] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Copy one owned face layer into a contiguous buffer (UNPACK=false),\n// or write a received buffer into the halo layer (UNPACK=true).\ntemplate <bool UNPACK>\n__global__ void faceKernel(Real* __restrict__ field, Real* __restrict__ buf, const int d, const Geom g) {\n    const int axis = d >> 1;\n    const bool hi = (d & 1) != 0;\n    const int L[3] = {g.lx, g.ly, g.lz};\n    const int a0 = (axis == 0) ? 1 : 0;\n    const int a1 = (axis == 2) ? 1 : 2;\n    const int nu = L[a0];\n    const int nv = L[a1];\n    int c[3];\n    if (UNPACK) {\n        c[axis] = hi ? L[axis] : -1;\n    } else {\n        c[axis] = hi ? L[axis] - 1 : 0;\n    }\n    for (int v = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y; v < nv; v += gridDim.y * blockDim.y) {\n        for (int u = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; u < nu; u += gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n            c[a0] = u;\n            c[a1] = v;\n            const size_t p = padIdx(c[0], c[1], c[2], g.sx, g.sy);\n            const size_t q = static_cast<size_t>(v) * nu + u;\n            if (UNPACK) {\n                field[p] = buf[q];\n            } else {\n                buf[q] = field[p];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void launchStencil(const Real* in, Real* out, const Box& b, const Geom& g, cudaStream_t s) {\n    if (b.ex <= 0 || b.ey <= 0 || b.ez <= 0) return;\n    const dim3 block(32, 8, 1);\n    const dim3 grid((b.ex + 31) / 32, std::min((b.ey + 7) / 8, 65535), std::min(b.ez, 65535));\n    stencilBoxKernel<<<grid, block, 0, s>>>(in, out, b, g);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\ntemplate <bool UNPACK>\nstatic void launchFaces(Real* field, Real* packed, const int nb[6], const size_t off[6], const Geom& g,\n                        cudaStream_t s) {\n    const int L[3] = {g.lx, g.ly, g.lz};\n    for (int d = 0; d < 6; ++d) {\n        if (nb[d] == MPI_PROC_NULL) continue;  // no neighbor on this side\n        const int axis = d >> 1;\n        const int a0 = (axis == 0) ? 1 : 0;\n        const int a1 = (axis == 2) ? 1 : 2;\n        const dim3 block(32, 8, 1);\n        const dim3 grid((L[a0] + 31) / 32, std::min((L[a1] + 7) / 8, 65535), 1);\n        faceKernel<UNPACK><<<grid, block, 0, s>>>(field, packed + off[d], d, g);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n}\n\n// Exchange packed faces with the 6 neighbors (MPI_PROC_NULL sides are no-ops).\nstatic void exchangeHalos(const int nb[6], const size_t off[6], const size_t cnt[6], Real* hSend, Real* hRecv,\n                          MPI_Comm comm) {\n    MPI_Request req[12];\n    int n = 0;\n    for (int d = 0; d < 6; ++d) {\n        // Data arriving on my side d was sent by neighbor d as its face d^1.\n        MPI_Irecv(hRecv + off[d], static_cast<int>(cnt[d]), MPI_DOUBLE, nb[d], d ^ 1, comm, &req[n++]);\n    }\n    for (int d = 0; d < 6; ++d) {\n        MPI_Isend(hSend + off[d], static_cast<int>(cnt[d]), MPI_DOUBLE, nb[d], d, comm, &req[n++]);\n    }\n    MPI_Waitall(n, req, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n}\n\n// OpenMP-parallel initialization of owned cells (global index formula from the serial code)\nstatic void initializeLocal(std::vector<Real>& pad, const Geom& g) {\n#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (int z = 0; z < g.lz; ++z) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < g.ly; ++y) {\n            for (int x = 0; x < g.lx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(static_cast<size_t>(g.x0 + x), static_cast<size_t>(g.y0 + y),\n                                        static_cast<size_t>(g.z0 + z), static_cast<size_t>(g.nx),\n                                        static_cast<size_t>(g.ny));\n                pad[padIdx(x, y, z, g.sx, g.sy)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// OpenMP-parallel extraction of the owned block into a contiguous (z,y,x) array\nstatic void extractOwned(const std::vector<Real>& pad, std::vector<Real>& block, const Geom& g) {\n    block.resize(static_cast<size_t>(g.lx) * g.ly * g.lz);\n#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (int z = 0; z < g.lz; ++z) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < g.ly; ++y) {\n            for (int x = 0; x < g.lx; ++x) {\n                block[(static_cast<size_t>(z) * g.ly + y) * g.lx + x] = pad[padIdx(x, y, z, g.sx, g.sy)];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// OpenMP-parallel scatter of a contiguous block into the global grid\nstatic void scatterBlock(std::vector<Real>& global, const std::vector<Real>& block, const int x0, const int y0,\n                         const int z0, const int lx, const int ly, const int lz, const int nx, const int ny) {\n#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (int z = 0; z < lz; ++z) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < ly; ++y) {\n            for (int x = 0; x < lx; ++x) {\n                const size_t gi = idx3(static_cast<size_t>(x0 + x), static_cast<size_t>(y0 + y),\n                                       static_cast<size_t>(z0 + z), static_cast<size_t>(nx), static_cast<size_t>(ny));\n                global[gi] = block[(static_cast<size_t>(z) * ly + y) * lx + x];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nstruct Options {\n    size_t nx;\n    size_t ny;\n    size_t nz;\n    int iterations;\n    bool validate;\n    bool printResults;\n};\n\n// Runs the distributed benchmark on the communicator `cart` (3D Cartesian, dims given).\n// Returns the process exit code (identical on all active ranks).\nstatic int runBenchmark(MPI_Comm cart, const Options& opt, const int dims[3], const int localRank) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(cart, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(cart, &size);\n    const size_t nx = opt.nx;\n    const size_t ny = opt.ny;\n    const size_t nz = opt.nz;\n    const int iterations = opt.iterations;\n    const bool validate = opt.validate;\n    const bool printResults = opt.printResults;\n\n    int coords[3];\n    MPI_Cart_coords(cart, rank, 3, coords);\n\n    int nb[6];  // neighbor ranks per face (MPI_PROC_NULL at domain edges)\n    for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {\n        int src = MPI_PROC_NULL;\n        int dst = MPI_PROC_NULL;\n        MPI_Cart_shift(cart, a, 1, &src, &dst);\n        nb[2 * a] = src;\n        nb[2 * a + 1] = dst;\n    }\n\n    const Range rx = blockRange(static_cast<int>(nx), dims[0], coords[0]);\n    const Range ry = blockRange(static_cast<int>(ny), dims[1], coords[1]);\n    const Range rz = blockRange(static_cast<int>(nz), dims[2], coords[2]);\n    Geom g{};\n    g.nx = static_cast<int>(nx);\n    g.ny = static_cast<int>(ny);\n    g.nz = static_cast<int>(nz);\n    g.x0 = rx.start;\n    g.y0 = ry.start;\n    g.z0 = rz.start;\n    g.lx = rx.len;\n    g.ly = ry.len;\n    g.lz = rz.len;\n    g.sx = g.lx + 2;\n    g.sy = g.ly + 2;\n\n    // One GPU per rank: select device by node-local rank\n    int numDevices = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&numDevices));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % numDevices));\n\n    // Device buffers (double buffering, padded with one halo layer)\n    const size_t padTotal = static_cast<size_t>(g.sx) * g.sy * (g.lz + 2);\n    Real* dGrid[2];\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dGrid[b], padTotal * sizeof(Real)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dGrid[b], 0, padTotal * sizeof(Real)));\n    }\n\n    // Packed halo buffers: device pack/unpack, pinned host staging for MPI\n    size_t faceOff[6];\n    size_t faceCnt[6];\n    const size_t faceTotal = faceLayout(g, faceOff, faceCnt);\n    Real *dPack, *dHalo, *hSend, *hRecv;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPack, faceTotal * sizeof(Real)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dHalo, faceTotal * sizeof(Real)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hSend, faceTotal * sizeof(Real)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hRecv, faceTotal * sizeof(Real)));\n    memset(hSend, 0, faceTotal * sizeof(Real));\n    memset(hRecv, 0, faceTotal * sizeof(Real));\n\n    cudaStream_t sComp, sComm;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sComp, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sComm, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n    cudaEvent_t evHalo, evShell;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evHalo, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evShell, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n\n    // Initialize\n    if (rank == 0) printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    {\n        std::vector<Real> pad(padTotal, 0.0);\n        initializeLocal(pad, g);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dGrid[0], pad.data(), padTotal * sizeof(Real), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    const std::vector<Box> shells = buildShells(g.lx, g.ly, g.lz);\n    const Box interior = buildInterior(g.lx, g.ly, g.lz);\n\n    // Run stencil iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        const Real* in = dGrid[cur];\n        Real* out = dGrid[1 - cur];\n\n        // (1) Interior update: needs no halo data (overlaps with communication)\n        launchStencil(in, out, interior, g, sComp);\n\n        // (2) Halo exchange on the communication stream\n        if (iter > 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sComm, evShell, 0));  // previous iteration's output ready\n        launchFaces<false>(dGrid[cur], dPack, nb, faceOff, g, sComm);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hSend, dPack, faceTotal * sizeof(Real), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sComm));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(sComm));\n        exchangeHalos(nb, faceOff, faceCnt, hSend, hRecv, cart);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dHalo, hRecv, faceTotal * sizeof(Real), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, sComm));\n        launchFaces<true>(dGrid[cur], dHalo, nb, faceOff, g, sComm);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evHalo, sComm));\n\n        // (3) Boundary shell: needs fresh halos\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sComp, evHalo, 0));\n        for (const Box& b : shells) {\n            launchStencil(in, out, b, g, sComp);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evShell, sComp));\n\n        cur = 1 - cur;\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    long long localMs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();\n    long long maxMs = 0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localMs, &maxMs, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, cart);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(maxMs));\n\n        // Calculate performance metrics\n        const double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n        const double mcups = cellUpdates / (maxMs / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n    }\n\n    // Gather final grid (only needed for result printing / validation)\n    const int finalIdx = (iterations % 2 == 0) ? 0 : 1;\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n extractOwned(pad, local, g);\n\n        std::vector<Real> global;\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            global.resize(nx * ny * nz);\n            scatterBlock(global, local, g.x0, g.y0, g.z0, g.lx, const Range qx = blockRange(g.nx, dims[0], c[0]);\n                const Range qy = blockRange(g.ny, dims[1], c[1]);\n                const Range qz = blockRange(g.nz, dims[2], c[2]);\n
